The '''Gorax King''' was a [[Gorax/Legends|Gorax]] who featured in the mythology of the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]. According to an Ewok legend, the Gorax King was imprisoned in the night sky above [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] by the [[Golden One/Legends|golden sun god]]. The Ewoks referred to the [[Din Nebula/Legends|Din Nebula]] as the "Gorax King's Heart," in reference to the legend.
